display_scale_note: Terrain is 1:1 with the 64px tile. Widelands buildings and trees use scale 2 so their authored hotspots stay the ground contact. Workers use scale 4 so a carrier frame sits near the wizard's height. OpenRA sprites use scale 2, except the 24px gun turret at scale 3.
remap_note: temperat.pal indices 80..95: the player-colour ramp baked into these PNGs; the faction shader maps these exact colours.
